note: BH-8640. pool_rootfs_resolve cuts its one `fly machine run --help` probe (does flyctl have --rootfs-size?) after this many seconds. The probe runs only when ROOTFS_GB is a valid nonzero row. A cut probe reads as no flag: the machine launches on the Fly default rootfs and logs one `rootfs row not used` line. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.pool_rootfs_probe_timeout_s`. A value that is not a whole number in 1..120 uses 20.
